Members@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}, @UUID[JournalEntry.zQMt8VMfKPoL6INq]{Celeste Arden}, @UUID[JournalEntry.PBJeE9T9n0BjB6ag]{Ezra “Static” Lund}, @UUID[JournalEntry.rg50DlMYSzgbZeBv]{Nadia Ferro}, @UUID[JournalEntry.B4nqUk8dojvCw97H]{Halvard “Hal” Brekke}, @UUID[JournalEntry.gRfqeOIXEHOcLemr]{Dr. Ruth Abernathy}

Handout@UUID[JournalEntry.vtenvgNlXVPd99Rc]{“Your Folder in the File”}

A coterie born of a shared threat: they all appear in the Ward File, and either they recover it together or they go down together.

Commando: a unit assembled for a mission that became permanent (doc 02). If it survives AVE-01, it can become Cerberus or Regency depending on the ending (doc 08).

Domain

  • Chasse 2: Night-shift workers. Hunting is possible, but you have to be careful.
  • Lien 1: The coterie has barely any influence over the mortals at the port. Bear knows a few.
  • Portillon 2: Lots of access points, containers, and water. Easy to get in and out. For enemies too.
